note: Spent privileged fixtures (the 341 arm-stress classes): used only to verify transformation lawfulness and comparator stability. They are not new independent evidence and are never used for policy selection or training.

d4.claim: D4 LAWFUL AND LABEL-EQUIVARIANT FOR EVERY CLASS AND ELEMENT (tolerance 0)

comparatorStability.decision: A comparator projection may be a policy input only if admissibleAsPolicyFeature is true (zero instability under relabel, menu order and D4 on all classes). Unstable projections stay in the evaluation as comparators but are excluded as features.
